identity.name: Inter-office Collaboration
identity.description: Short-term project aligning implementation, support, SLA, and escalation processes uniformly across SA, UAE, and India.

goals: Align implementation, support, SLA, and escalation processes uniformly across SA, UAE, and India
Establish shared standards for delivery quality and client communication
Ensure cross-region handoffs and escalations work without friction
Deliver measurable improvements in inter-office collaboration within the project's short-term window

milestones.name: Cross-region process audit complete (SA, UAE, India gaps identified)
Unified escalation and SLA standards published
All regions operating under unified process

risks.description: Regional teams agree to unified process on paper but revert to local habits
risks.mitigation: Regular cross-region check-ins; measurable compliance metrics, not just documentation

risks.description: Short-term project window closes before lasting change takes hold
risks.mitigation: Embed process changes into tools and workflows (YouTrack, Zoho) so they persist after project ends

dependencies.description: Support process is a core area being unified across regions
Implementation process depends on V8 deployment standards

notes: Short-term, high-importance project. The goal is to get SA, UAE, and India operating uniformly on implementation, support, SLAs, and escalations. This is important for the group — if regional processes don't align, POS X rollout across geographies will be chaotic. Changes must be embedded in tools (YouTrack, Zoho) so they outlive the project itself.
